an9.38:1.1: dve lokāyatikā brāhmaṇā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
an9.38:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te brāhmaṇā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
an9.38:2.1: pūraṇo bho gotama kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesañāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti
an9.38:2.2: carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca me suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti
an9.38:2.4: ahaṃ anantena ñāṇena anantaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharāmīti
an9.38:2.5: ayampi hi bho gotama nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesañāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti
an9.38:2.6: carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca me suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti
an9.38:2.8: ahaṃ anantena ñāṇena anantaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharāmīti
an9.38:2.9: imesaṃ bho gotama ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ ko musāti.
an9.38:3.3: imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ ko musā
an9.38:3.5: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti.
an9.38:3.6: evaṃ bhoti kho te brāhmaṇā bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an9.38:4.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā cattāro purisā catuddisā ṭhitā purisagatiyā ca javena samannāgatā paramena ca padavītihārena
an9.38:4.2: evarūpena javena samannāgatā assu seyyathāpi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katupāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchātiṃ atipāteyya
an9.38:4.3: evarūpena ca padavītihārena seyyathāpi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo
an9.38:4.4: atha puratthimāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya
an9.38:4.6: so aññatreva asitakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antamantarā kālaṃ kareyya
an9.38:4.9: dakkhiṇāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya
an9.38:4.11: so aññatreva asitakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antamantarā kālaṃ kareyya
an9.38:4.13: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇā evarūpāya sandhāvanikāya lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ diṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmi
an9.38:4.14: na cāhaṃ brāhmaṇā appatvāva lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an9.38:5.1: pañcime brāhmaṇā kāmaguṇā ariyassa vinaye lokoti vuccati.
an9.38:5.3: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
an9.38:5.7: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
an9.38:5.8: ime kho brāhmaṇā pañca kāmaguṇā ariyassa vinaye lokoti vuccati.
an9.38:6.1: idha brāhmaṇā bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.38:6.2: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā bhikkhu lokassa antamagamā lokassa ante viharati
an9.38:7.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā bhakkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyajjhānaṃ
an9.38:7.4: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā bhikkhu lokassa antamagamā lokassa ante viharati
an9.38:8.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.38:8.2: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā bhikkhu lokassa antamagamā lokassa ante viharati
an9.38:9.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an9.38:9.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.38:9.3: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.38:9.4: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā bhikkhu lokassa antamagamā lokassa ante viharati
an9.38:10.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇā bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāyapassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti
an9.38:10.2: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇā bhikkhu lokassa antamagamā lokassa ante viharati tiṇṇo loke visattikanti. 39
